batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b DJ Bravo

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b R Ashwin

batting.name: SP Narine
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b RA Jadeja

batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b L Balaji

batting.dismissal: c SP Narine b YK Pathan

balls.text: has a slog at a high full toss, and hits it back to the bowler, nearly carries to him
hit down to long on
tries to walk across and scoop over short fine, misses this one just outside off
slow offcutter lifted over the bowler, Jadeja puts in the slide from long on
makes room, walks out and swats a shortish one wide of the sweeper
cramped for room with one angled in fullish, tries to force it away, hits it to the bowler
opens the face to a shortish one and runs it to third man
on the pad, flicked through square leg
Balaji's confidently pulled this short of a length delivery in the gap between deep midwicket and long on
steers this widish length ball to third man
comes in from a length, turned to square leg
bowler goes sprawling to his right and stops this push off a length ball
straightens and bounces around off, he plays it from the crease and is a touch late in patting it away
pushes it to extra cover
goes for it once more as Jadeja angles it across, and this time he picks out deep midwicket, getting too much height on the shot
Narine's launched another one over deep midwicket, with the turn this time, fetching it from around off
punches a flat length ball past extra cover's dive, which takes pace off it
carrom ball pushed wide of cover
hit in the air down to long on
Narine swings and lifts this length ball over deep midwicket from outside off
this hurried in from round the stumps, thick inside edge saves him
offbreak spins in sharply, cut to the sweeper
dabs a tossed up ball outside off to short third
turns it with the spin in the air, well short of midwicket
Jadeja strikes again, length ball angled in on the stumps, batsman misses on the sweep, Jadeja hits pad in front of middle and umpire Rauf agrees with the appeal
eases a tossed up ball to long off
oh dear, Bhatia's pushed this length delivery straight back to the bowler, sums up KKR's evening
turned off the pad in front of square leg
angled in, he is on the front foot to defend down the pitch
turns an offbreak to forward square leg
slapped to extra cover again from the crease
other one pushed to extra cover
chopped into the pitch as this spins in sharply
comes out, beaten in the flight as it dips before him, nudges to midwicket
Tiwary has come down the track, he's lofted this flighted offbreak on middle with the turn, but deep midwicket is in the way
backs away to leg, Jadeja follows him, nudged behind square leg
pushes in the air to midwicket, bowler runs after it
straightening on middle, he thick edges behind point
defended off the front foot
skips out and mishits in the gap between deep midwicket and long on, who runs around to it
looked like the other one, pitched up, pushed to the bowler
tossed up slowly, dips, spin, and bounces, Bhatia pops it on the forward push to vacant short leg
long appeal and he;s been given, got down to sweep this offbreak, missed, it spun in and hit the pad in front of middle and leg
swung through midwicket, and had Dhoni taken this throw from deep midwicket, this would have been the 43rd run out today
slogged over deep midwicket just over the fielder's reach
backs away to leg, he tosses it up outside off, sound as ball passes the attempted big drive, but Dhoni cannot gather that
yet another tight single, to midwicket again, and Jadeja misses with the throw once more, that was another run out had he hit
walks out, Jadeja shortens it, worked through midwicket off the pad
another close single, Jadeja gets to this nudge in front of midwicket, direct hit would have meant another run out
tossed up fullish, pushed to extra cover
gets bat around front pad to work this skiddy length ball through midwicket
tossed up around off and eased past extra cover
flighted full and wide, he reaches it to drive to the sweeper
flat and shortish, pulled down to long on
another carrom ball, pushed back to the bowler
carrom ball straightens around off, he is forward to keep it out
length ball turning in around off, defended
floated up full outside off, driven to the sweeper
this one;s been taken, by the KKR bowling mentor in the dugout, pitched up on the stumps, and Das lifts it just over long on
into the pads, but he misses with the bat, and it rolls to the keeper
this slower one cut in sharply, he was coming forward to push, inside edge onto pad
lots of width, but he;s steered it straight to point
another slower one, cutting into the pads, turned behind square
offcutter pitched up close to the stumps, he is forward to defend
tight line on off, opens the face to steer to point
they take on Jadeja at mid on with a sharp single, wonder what's the pressing need, a dive is required, Jadeja misses with the lob
slow and bowled full, patted down the pitch
gets on top of a short of a length ball and punches to third man
pushes it to point off the front foot
forward to defend a length ball

madness, big time, Yusuf gone now, works an offcutter to midwicket, and takes an age to decide to go for the second, he also stops midway, then resumes, Bravo charges after the ball, slides, picks it up, slips, recovers to throw it to the keeper, who has Yusuf short of his ground, and again, no need for the third umpire
fine leg is up, this is on the pads, and Tiwary is away with a tickle

another huge strike, all the big KKR batsmen are gone, Morgan walks out to a slower one, he is nowhere to the pitch, reaches out to it, and ends up chipping it high in the air over square leg, where Jadeja keeps his eyes on it, runs back and takes it over his shoulder
holds its line on a length around off, defends to the bowler
comes in again, from back of a length, he steers to third man
slow and cutting in on off, he stretches forward to defend
played out to mid on
good length, steps out to defend to extra cover
goes pushing at a length ball angled in, and is beaten
walks out and turns a length ball in front of square leg, and we have an overthrow as well
coming in with the angle from round the stumps, defended to leg

Kallis is gone without facing a ball, Badrinath the man, runs in from backward point as Yusuf runs a length delivery towards him, not much to aim at from that angle, but he;s hit, and umpire Rauf does not even need the third umpire's help
more effort on this length ball from Morris, comes in around off, chopped behind point
Michael Hussey takes a blinder at third man, this bounced sharply outside off, Gambhir cut in the air, it was dying on Hussey to his left, but Mr Cricket is there with a dive
short and wide, coming in, he steers in the air to third man
backs away to leg, and steers a shortish one to third man
overpitched and slowish around off, forced to mid off
back of a length, widish, he misses on the cut
length around off, dabbed to third man
was undecided what to do with this back of a length ball on the pads, got big on him as he made an effort to swing at it, top edge flies over keeper
clears front leg and creates room to cut this hard behind point, third man lets it slip through his hands, Mohit Sharma
slow length ball coming in, he adjusts to nudge to square leg
pitched up, skids into the pads, and rolls to the keeper
shortish, pulled hard to deep square leg
bouncer, always helps against YK, he swivels and swings at it, misses
low full toss pushed to mid off
makes some room and steers this down to square third man
carves a length delivery for cover to dive and save the boundary
worked to short fine, Hussey hits direct but Gambhir is home
length ball angled in, and Yusuf has launched it over mid on, the man there tries to stretch a hand up to it, but he's nowhere close
picked off the pads in the air to deep midwicket
is hit on the pad with one that pitched outside leg, they take the single, Morkel runs into YK as he tries to pick up the ball
there is wide slip, and the gap between him and keeper is enough for Gambhir to run this short of a length ball between them, a controlled Gambhir-Dab
cramps him with a length ball on the stumps, patted back
tries to whack this length ball over the bowler, but gets it high on the bat, and mid on gets around
holds its line from short of a length, Yusuf pushes at it, and is beaten
comes in from round the stumps, he mistimes the punch to covers
pushes off the front foot in front of mid off, and his big strides have him home safely, throw misses
pitched up now, around off, he gets front foot out and blocks
short of a length once more, there is a man at forward deep square, but Yusuf's swat has beaten him comfortably
outside off now, good length, he tries to drive but cannot get it past cover
back of a length, nipping in, not rising much, and Yusuf smashes it in front of deep square leg
length on the pads, flicked down to fine leg
tighter with the line now around off, he guides it behind point for a single
there's a small gap at cover, Gambhir has got on top of this length ball and timed it off the back foot, just past short cover-point
slight width on a good length, punched off the back foot to covers
floats it across the left-hander, who walks out and has a lazy drive at it to get beaten, all in slow motion
pitched up and swinging in down the pads
a gentle length ball moving across, and Gambhir has gone on his toes and run it to the third man boundary, beating the dive from the man in the deep
and he finishes the game with a six over deep midwicket, dragged shortish and he opens up in time to go through with the pull
length ball on the pads, worked to deep square
driven in the air, couple of a bounces to long off
slow bouncer, Bravo's got on top of it and smoothly pulled it behind square leg
pushed to long off
dropped, Yusuf has gone for the catch at deep square leg as Jadeja pulls a short ball, low to his left, he's tumbled for it, but it's gone down, and also rolled for four, what a miss
lovely placement, high full toss from Kallis, Jadeja's slices it past extra cover, and the sweeper has no chance
fires in a low full toss that is drilled down to long off
straighter one, runs it to short third man
full on the pads, he misses with the bat, takes the leg bye
backs away and cuts an offbreak, to point
Jadeja has cleared front leg and murdered this offbreak from outside off straight and high over Narine
carrom ball punched down the ground
short and angled in, Jadeja has dragged it over and wide of short fine leg, again didn't look like it was clearing the man, but it had more than enough
huge moment, Hussey's picked out deep square leg, walked down the pitch to a slow length ball and paddled it straight to the fielder
short of a length and into the body, he adjusts to help it around to short fine
into the pads from round the stumps, rolls away behind square
low full toss pushed to extra cover
Jadeja charges out second ball, makes some room outside leg and slams a length ball high and into the straight boundary, didn't look like clearing the rope but did so comfortably in the end
slogs this length ball over midwicket now for a couple
Hussey gets going finally, he bends the back knee and swipes this length ball miles into the sky and it eventually lands some metres beyond the deep square leg boundary
length ball on middle, steered to third man
gone on the paddle, plonked front foot outside off, lost balance as he went down and missed the full delivery, which was right on leg stump
slow bouncer, Badri can't get bat to ball as he comes out to have a swing
skips out and drills this length ball down to long off
flat and widish, he chops it wide of backward point
tries to cut a bouncing length offbreak, and is beaten, getting harder and harder
makes some room and tries to force this carrom ball away, thick inside edge to short fine leg
that skidded on to off, he keeps it out from the crease
drives a tossed up offbreak to sweeper cover
jabs a pitched up delivery to square leg
tries to paddle this full one outside off, is hit on the pad
can't work it off the pad, but takes the single as it rolls down the pitch
Tiwary goes flying to his right at backward point to parry this square drive towards cover, top effort
back of a length, turns it from off to midwicket
pitched up on middle, whipped to wide long on
slight width and he cuts this back of a length ball going across him, Balaji fumbles at third man to allow a second
whipped to deep square off the pad
can;t get pace as well as room, pushes it back to the bowler
stays in the crease and punches to long on
punches one cutting across out to the sweeper
comes forward again and drives past cover
good length outside off, he defends to cover off the front foot
goes across and nudges a length ball behind square leg
goes reaching to a widish length ball and is beaten, appeal for caught behind turned down
worked to deep square leg

Eoin Morgan takes the big wicket, Hussey pushed in front of extra cover, took a start, stopped, Dhoni, always eager for quick singles, raced out, stopped too late and turned back, Morgan charged in, picked it up, dived forward and lobbed it into the stumps, Dhoni turned back and started walking immediately
length on middle, he runs it to point
forces a length ball around off to fine leg
pushed to sweeper cover
loopy, slow, wide, full, he eases it to sweeper cover
cramped for room with a length ball angled in from round the stumps, pushed to the bowler
walks out, outside off, and works a length ball through midwicket
length outside off, steered to third man
punches a widish length ball that stayed low, to extra cover
nudged off the front foot, thrusting, awkward Dhoni fashion, behind square leg
slow length ball cutting across, pushed down to long off
slow leg cutter, punched to Balaji's left at sweeper cover, he puts in a big dive as it threatens to hurry past
cuts a length ball just outside off, wide of the sweeper
widish, pushed to the sweeper
punches a length ball to wide long off
Raina goes for maximum, lofting this full delivery with a straight followthrough, but long on is deep and he's positioned himself inches inside the rope to take it in front of his head
overpitched, pushed down to long on
worked to deep square off the pad
on the stumps, punched to extra cover
clears front leg and punches a length ball to cover
worked to square leg
tossed up full, pushed to the bowler
spins across sharply as he comes forward, waits and opens the face, it's beaten short third all the way to the boundary, wow
moves across and nudges to midwicket for a couple
walks out and punches in the air just past short extra cover
gone on the sweep, tossed up from round the stump, pitches off, hits him in front of middle on the knee roll, no issues with that
driven in the air, but wide of sweeper cover
appeal for lbw from the bowler as he comes forward and is hit on the pad with one that spins in and bounces, outside the line? no, hit in line but too high and lots of spin too
hit down to long on off the inner part of the blade as it skids on
steered to short third man, and they go through for the single
shortish, swatted to deep midwicket
pitches outside leg and spins in, Hussey cannot get the single as he works it to leg close to the pitch
dabs this flat offbreak behind point, Tiwary dives and prevents the single
steers an offbreak to short third for a quick single
bouncing and spinning away, cut straight to cover
plays from the crease, pushes a length delivery to off
tossed up, pushed down the track
tries to pull a pitched up delivery, misses, keeper does as well
that took off from a length, Hussey did well to let it go
goes across to defend a straight length ball on off
spins across Hussey, who whips it in front of square on leg
flighted full toss pushed to long on
widish offbreak swung straight to midwicket, and the experiment is over
straightens into the left-hander, turned in front of square leg
punches a straightish and quick length ball to point, who dives and stops it
leading edge to mid off as he tries working it square off the pad
gets it away this time with a sweep in the air over square leg
can;t find the gap, backs away again and slaps it to point
not getting the single to leg, sent back by Hussey
moves a long way outside leg, he slows it down, tosses it up a long way outside leg too, Ashwin is cramped and mishits to off
skips out and clips this off the pad, to midwicket
slowish length ball moving away, driven to point
beaten just outside off as this bounces from good length, Hussey tried running it to third man
walks down the pitch and pushes a length ball to the bowler
wide, too wide, and swinging away
opens the face, stays in the crease and runs a length ball to point
wide, and Hussey scatters the infield with superb placement through cover-point off the front foot
holds its line just outside off and beats him on the drive
quickish and full from round the stumps, worked back to the bowler
flighted into the pads, straightens, he plays from deep on the crease again, turns it square
goes deep in the crease to push to the bowler
tossed up too full again, and he puts it away through covers
overpitched, patted back to the bowler

what a miss, Hussey was caught way out of his crease here, charging for a non-existent single, but the throw missed from short midwicket, even if he had waited for a fielder/bowler to come up to the stumps, Hussey would have struggled
but he can time them alright, walks down the pitch, gets bat around pad to flick stylishly through square leg
softly pats this behind point, Hussey goes for the run, Ashwin is no Hussey, and he has clumsily dive in
mistimes a drive off this widish length ball, takes the single to point
pitched up and angled in, neat clip off the pads to midwicket
swings in sharply from round the stumps, Hussey wafts outside the line, keeper fails to gather cleanly
